name: Dove
summary: A Mayfair or Chelsea bridal salon in daylight: the gown in the salon's three-way mirror (front in the middle pane, side and detail angled in, one set), then two or three gowns each filling the screen as an editorial photograph with a quiet credit, the salon's room with the first appointment as a card and one Request that opens a sheet, the gown diary, trunk shows, visit. White and ivory so white gowns glow; dove grey for hairlines and the footer; the violet sheen of a dove's neck only for Request and one hairline. Gilda Display for names, Mulish for everything else. For bridal salons and couture houses.
